4bdb6d39f683fd8715294b62ab9da2482b8fe5e8.summary: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. Saved selections are untouched. - The reasoning effort dropdown shows the effort a new task will actually use, and has a Default entry that clears the saved setting. - A provider's model list refreshes after you save its API key or base URL, and a failed refresh (such as a rejected key) shows as an error in the model picker. - `read_files` results are no longer cut to 8k characters on the way to the model. A read now arrives in full, up to the tool's own limit of 2000 lines or about 48k characters. - Refreshed the model catalog. Adds 94 providers from models.dev and drops Lilac and Tempr. The Cline recommended list adds Muse Ember. The Cline free list drops Reflection Beam, Laguna S 2.1 and Solar Mini 4. ClinePass drops DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Mimo V2.6 Flash, Mimo V2.6 Pro, MiniMax M3, Qwen3.7 Plus and Qwen3.7 Max. Default models change for 67 other providers, mostly to Kimi K3.1 Pro, Gemini 4 Neon (including the `gemini` and `vertex` providers) or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. ### Fixed - Picking "None" for reasoning effort is now saved and sent. Before, GPT-6 on Azure kept its default effort and rejected tool calls. - Turning reasoning off now reaches custom models that have saved Model Configuration overrides. ed8f0ab20585cec5465d80d4e4c616b483e54f09.summary: - The thinking picker offers **Max** reasoning effort, for models whose top level is max - A manual `/compact` can be stopped. Before, it could sit on "Thinking…" with no Stop button when the summarizer stalled - With no saved model, the Cline provider now starts on the first free model instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5. Saved selections are untouched - The Account view has a Privacy settings link to the Cline web app's data-use preferences - Settings → About has a **Third-party notices** entry with the licenses for the open source software included in Cline - On macOS, Check for Updates from the menu runs once instead of twice - Refreshed colours and typography across the app - `read_files` results are no longer cut to 8k characters on the way to the model. A read now arrives in full, up to the tool's own limit of 2000 lines or about 48k characters - Reflection Beam no longer fails every turn with `400 Missing required parameter: 'messages[n].reasoning_content'` after a compaction or a model switch - Compaction no longer falls back to the basic summary on models the catalog doesn't describe. The summarizer was sending `reasoning_effort: "none"`, which some endpoints reject - Turning reasoning off now reaches custom models that have saved Model Configuration overrides. Before, gpt-5.6 and gpt-6 chat-completions endpoints rejected every tool call - On the native OpenAI provider, the reasoning level is fitted to what each model supports, so `max` and Extra High are no longer rejected by GPT-5.x and o-series models - LiteLLM: the legacy `max_tokens` field is no longer used as the input budget when the model reports `max_output_tokens` - Refreshed the model catalog. Adds 94 providers from models.dev and drops Lilac and Tempr. The Cline recommended list adds Muse Ember. The Cline free list drops Reflection Beam, Laguna S 2.1 and Solar Mini 4. ClinePass drops DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Mimo V2.6 Flash, Mimo V2.6 Pro, MiniMax M3, Qwen3.7 Plus and Qwen3.7 Max. Default models change for 67 other providers, mostly to Kimi K3.1 Pro, Gemini 4 Neon (including the `gemini` and `vertex` providers) or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/desktop-v0.0.49...desktop-v0.0.50

fdc4cffb6fa79465efcbc61e54626501271b8591.summary: ## What's changed - Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after `claude auth login`, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway - Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in `/config` - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1` to print the full sign-in link, if the short one shows an error or a script reads values from it - Self-hosted runner: Added `--start-dir` / `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_START_DIR` to have Claude start its work in a folder of a repository, while settings and hooks load as without it - Added a notice in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions when a plugin marketplace can't be fetched because its repository isn't one of the session's - Self-hosted runner: Added a notice when Anthropic-managed git refuses a plugin's own repository, naming the plugin and what to do - Added `commandPrinted` to `claude plugin install --json` results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and `commandFailed` when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out - Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_registered_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order issued to registration accepted, on orchestrator-spawned runners - Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order to first session handed over, on runners started for a session - Fixed Claude Code freezing for up to several minutes right after compacting a very long conversation - Fixed WebFetch freezing the session for minutes on some pages, and returning an empty result for some others - Fixed `ExitWorktree` and the worktree exit dialog deleting a worktree that another running Claude Code session was working in - Fixed changes to user settings being lost when several Claude Code processes saved them at the same time - Fixed `--continue` and `--resume` opening an empty session or failing when the last saved message had a missing or invalid timestamp - Fixed the first prompt after a sleep of two minutes or more waiting three minutes on a connection that had died, on Linux and WSL - Fixed turns failing with "JSON schema is invalid", and session files growing by many megabytes, when many MCP tools have an input schema that the API refuses - Linux: Fixed Bash commands waiting seconds and showing no file diff for the rest of a session in slow repositories with large ignored folders such as `node_modules` - Windows: Fixed Bash commands running slower for the rest of a session after Git Bash took 10 to 60 seconds to start, on machines with no custom start-up files - Fixed `/rewind` sometimes restoring an older version of a file when two queued prompts, or stacked skills, ran together right after a turn that changed it - Fixed text and images added when approving a permission prompt being dropped when the approved command or tool then failed - Fixed MCP resources from claude.ai connectors and plugin servers not being attached when @-mentioned
